title: Zesty Nutty Korean Barramundi Anju
description: A festive Korean dish featuring barramundi, with a nutty and shaggy texture, steamed to perfection and served as anju, FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Rinse the barramundi fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
Cut the barramundi into small pieces, about 1 inch in size.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, korean chili flakes, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the barramundi pieces to the bowl, toss to coat with the marinade, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Prepare the steamer basket with a layer of green onions, then add the marinated barramundi pieces on top.
Steam the barramundi over boiling water for 8 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a small pan, toast the ginkgo nuts over medium heat, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Sprinkle the toasted ginkgo nuts, toasted sesame seeds, and chopped green onions over the steamed barramundi.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
